title: Dead-seat detection (detección de puesto muerto): idle seat → Idle status, excluded from round payout
description: Filed from TASK-054's AC3 audit (dev-t101, item 5). GDD Annex D.1 'Adaptador HID → InputSnapshot' row / §3.2 names 'detección de puesto muerto': a seat with no input for ~45 s is marked Idle — excluded from that round's payout but NOT eliminated from the session (they can resume by touching the controls). FINDING: this is entirely unimplemented — no per-seat last-input-edge tracking or Idle marking exists in ArcadeInputBridge, InputInterpreter, or SessionStateMachine (verified during TASK-054). WORK (Core-side, fast-testable): track last-activity tick per claimed seat (any edge or stick movement; likely InputInterpreter or FSM-side using its outputs — design call), have SessionStateMachine derive an Idle status after the GDD threshold (VERIFY the exact number and semantics against the GDD text firsthand — the 45 s figure and 'excluded from payout, not eliminated' semantics come from the TASK-054 audit report and must be re-confirmed against the source; [ASSUMED]-tag any gap the GDD leaves, e.g. whether Idle seats still stake in FINAL_WAGER, whether resume takes effect same-round or next-round, HUD signaling). Integrate with payout application (Idle seat excluded from that round's payout) without breaking pot conservation or the TASK-051/052 pinned tests.
acceptance_criteria: Per-seat activity tracking marks a claimed seat Idle after the GDD-specified no-input window (threshold verified against the GDD firsthand and cited; [ASSUMED]-tagged if the GDD is ambiguous).

An Idle seat is excluded from the round payout in which it is Idle but remains in the session and resumes on input, per GDD semantics; interactions with FINAL_WAGER/climax are decided and [ASSUMED]-tagged where the GDD is silent.
Tests (tdd tier) pin: idle-threshold crossing, payout exclusion for the idle round, resume behavior, and no regression to pot conservation or existing TASK-051/052 scoring pins.
Fast suite green; any Framework/HUD signaling surface is scoped out or Unity-gated separately.

comments.body:
CLOSED (loop mode, auto_close_on_green_review). rev-t056 fresh-context review of 1296d42..8fc43bb → APPROVE, ZERO findings (0 HIGH/0 MEDIUM/0 LOW). Orchestrator INDEPENDENTLY ran the fast suite = 590 passed / 0 failed (582 + 8 dead-seat tests), zero regression. Depth FULL.

COMMITS: fd3ad8d (test: GENUINE BEHAVIORAL red — reviewer verified its SessionStateMachine.cs diff is EMPTY; the inert IdleTimeoutSeconds config field it carries only lets the tests compile, no marking behavior) → 8fc43bb (feat: green). Files: SessionStateMachine.cs (+129, detection/exclusion + LOW-2 doc), SessionStateMachineConfig.cs (+22, IdleTimeoutSeconds default 45f), SessionStateMachineTests.cs (+290, 8 tests). No new files, no csproj change.

AC VERDICTS (all MET): AC1 45s→2700-tick threshold (SessionStateMachine.cs:322, cites GDD §3.2 l.224), pinned both sides (Human@2699/Idle@2700 + 30-tick window). AC2 competitive place-zeroing (:658-659) + coop PayoutEligibleSeatsMask() (:699) + resume-on-flanco (:882-885); tests assert {0,4,2,1} competitive, {0,4,4,4} coop, +6 R2 resume. AC3 pot-conservation test + TASK-051/052 pins green. AC4 Core-only, HUD via public Roster.Seats for a later Unity-gated ticket.

POT-CONSERVATION = HOLDS, with an IMPORTANT REVIEWER CORRECTION recorded: regular-round competitive payout is an ADDITIVE MINT (faucet), NOT a fixed-pot split — GDD l.224 says 'se excluye del reparto' (excluded), NOT 'redistribuido'. So the FAITHFUL behavior is pure WITHHOLDING of the idle seat's own mint (touches ONLY the excluded seat; other seats' places untouched → identical payouts). REDISTRIBUTING the idle share to others would be WRONG (invent coins / alter others' pay). The one true fixed-pot invariant (FINAL_WAGER) is entirely untouched — ActiveSeatsMask deliberately KEEPS idle seats for staking/podium; SessionWithIdleSeat test verifies Σshares==Pot + non-negative balances. TASK-051/052 pins hold LOGICALLY (exclusion reuses the pre-existing place-0=absent branch; PayoutEligibleSeatsMask ≡ ActiveSeatsMask when no seat is Idle).

HumanIdle reuse confirmed (SeatState.cs:12, no new status); transition IN only Human→Idle during game states after threshold, OUT on any flanco (resume, never elimination); Bot/Empty never tracked; counters re-seeded at roster build (no stale cross-session state).

RIDER: LOW-2 FIXED consistent (Coins doc :366 repointed at the real class-doc note at :96). LOW-4 deliberately SKIPPED, LEFT CONSISTENT (coop guard still ArgumentException byte-identical to TASK-052; throw+test mutually consistent — flipping to InvalidOperationException would force editing the pinned test in lockstep for a cosmetic change; correct per 'don't half-do it').

[ASSUMED] RATIFICATION (all reviewer-judged ratify-OK; added to bundle list): (1) edge source = debounced button edge OR raw 8-way stick-direction change (stick-only move counts as activity); (2) IsGameState scope = BoardMove..Intermission + FinalWager/FinalMg, excl. Attract/Join/GameOver; (3) RESUME SAME-TICK, no same-round latch — a seat resuming one tick before MgResult IS paid that round (player-friendly; SOFT NEEDS-HUMAN one-line confirm — a designer might prefer a latch); (4) FINAL_WAGER staking unchanged for Idle seats (reparto-only exclusion; win-credit still uses rank.Place, inert since a silent seat won't rank #1); (5) HUD/View Idle signaling deferred (Unity-gated). Item (3) flagged to the human ratification list as the one worth confirming.

Reviewer offered an optional >=→> boundary mutation — already provided as evidence in the dev's hand-off (both threshold tests fail under it), so not re-run.
